method: git archive <branch> <paths> | tar -x into scratch, then rsync -a --ignore-existing into the worktree; before each rsync every archive file was classified added/skipped and md5s of all pre-existing files were recorded; after each rsync every added file was cmp-verified against the archive and every pre-existing file md5-verified unchanged (verify_bad=0 for all sources). No existing file in the worktree was overwritten by B1.
